{{Top|leg}}
'''Circuitry cooling cables''' were used to prevent overheating in [[Droid/Legends|droid]] construction. [[3D-4X administrative droid]]s featured exposed cooling cables that ran from their knee joints to the top of their shins.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
